name: DMMDA-2
summary: DMMDA-2, also known as 2,3-dimethoxy-4,5-methylenedioxyamphetamine or as 5,6-dimethoxy-MDA, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to MDA. It is the derivative of MDA with methoxy groups at the 5 and 6 positions and of MMDA and MMDA-2 with an additional methoxy group at either of these positions.

pharmacology.text: DMMDA-2 showed reduced albeit significant activity as a serotonin releasing agent compared to certain related compounds like MDA and MMDA. It showed no activity as a dopamine releasing agent, in contrast to MDA but similarly to MMDA and MMDA-2. Whereas DMMDA-2 significantly induced serotonin release, MMDA-2 was inactive in terms of serotonin and dopamine release induction.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin releasing agent
